On dividing a certain number by 304, we get 43 as the remainder. If the same number is divided by 16, what will be the remainder?
questions.solution_en:
Let the required number be N. Given:

When N is divided by 304, the remainder is 43.

This implies N = 304k + 43 for some integer k.

To find the remainder when N is divided by 16, observe:

304 is a multiple of 16 (304 = 16 X 19).

Therefore, 304k is divisible by 16, and N mod 16 depends only on 43 mod 16.

43 divided by 16 leaves a remainder of 11.

Hence, the remainder is 11.

questions.q_en: When a number is successively divided by 3, 4 and 7, the remainder obtained is 2, 3 and 5, respectively. What will be the remainder when 42 divides the same number?
questions.solution_en:
Let number = N

Let two quotients are 'a' and 'b' respectively.

b = 7 * 1 + 5 = 12

a = 12 * 4 + 3 = 51

N = 51 * 3 + 2 = 155 = 3 * 42 + 29

Remainder when 155 is divided by 42 is 29.

questions.q_en: What is the cube root of the product of all positive multiples of 8 less than 45?
questions.solution_en:
For perfect cube, number of zeroes should be 3, 6, 9 etc.

(a) 1000000, since it has 6 zeroes, so cube root = 103

(b) 2160000 - 4 zeroes

(c) 194000 = 194 * 1000 => 194 is not a perfect cube)

(d) 12500000 - 5 zeroes

Hence, option 'a' is correct.

If P and Q are two distinct prime numbers less than 20, then which of the following statement cannot be true?

I: 2P + 3Q can be even.

II: Maximum value of (P + Q)/(P - Q) is more than 15.
questions.solution_en:
P and Q can be 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17 or 19.

I: If we take Q = 2, then the value of 2P + 3Q will be even.

II: For maximum value, the value of (P+Q) is maximum and (P - Q) is minimum.

Let P = 19 and Q = 17

(17 + 19)/(19 - 17) = 18

So, option 'd' is correct.

questions.q_en: How many whole numbers are there between 109 and 345 which are exactly divisible by 11?
questions.solution_en:
Smallest number divisible by 11 between 109 and 345 = 110

Largest number divisible by 11 between 109 and 345 = 341

Formed an A.P. with a = 110, d = 11 and an = 341

an = a + (n - 1)d

341 = 110 + (n - 1)11

231 = 11n - 11

11n = 242

n = 22

questions.q_en:
Which of the following numbers has a terminating decimal?

349/85, 347/80, 651/45, 333/82
questions.solution_en:
[If the denominator contains only factors of 2 and /or 5, then its decimal expansion will terminate]

(a) 651/45

Factor of 45 = 5 * 9 [non-terminating decimal]

(b) 347/80

Factor of 80 = 2 * 2 * 2 * 2 * 5 [Terminating decimal]

(c) 333/82

Factor of 82 = 2 * 41 [non-terminating decimal]

(d) 349/85

Factor of 85 = 5 * 17 [non-terminating decimal]

questions.q_en: If the digits of a two-digit number are interchanged, the value of the number decreases by 18. The digit at the tens place is double the digit at unit place. What is the number?
questions.solution_en:
Let the two-digit number be 10x + y.

Numbers obtained by interchanging the digits = 10y + x

∴ (10x + y) - (10y + x) = 18

=> 9x - 9y = 18

=> x - y = 2 ..(i)

Also, y = x/2

=> 2y = x ..(ii)

From (i) and (ii), y = 2 and x = 4.

∴ The number is 42.

questions.q_en: If A = 4√7, B = 5√5 and C = 3√11, then which of the following statement(s) is/are true?
questions.solution_en:
A = 4√7, B = 5√5 and C = 3√11

Taking square of A, B and C we get,

A2 = 112, B2 = 125 and C2 = 99

Then, A2 < B2,, B2 > C2 and A2 > C2

Therefore, A < B, B > C, A > C

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.
